Absolute insane Ship but highly functional:

1. ~  2k Legendary Iron Plates per minute
2. ~ 60 Legendary  Calcite  per minute
3. ~ 100 Coal Legendary  per minute

The best thing - beside not looking like a p€n!s - is, that it's powered by nuclear so you can use it before Aquilo, you might need 10+ in Asteroid productivity to work properly. 

All items can be downgraded, I haven't tested that but should work just much slower.

Credits to abucnasty for the initial design, I just transformed it to this behemoth with nuclear power.

Check out his YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@abucnasty, or github (https://github.com/abucnasty/factorio-benchmarks/tree/master/docs/blueprints) he has some great designs and ideas.
title: [quality=legendary] The Klonk | Nuclear Legendary Casino Ship | Big Ship = Big Reward
